I will post this phase-based outline to the "Engagement Suite – Cross‑Functional" workspace by tomorrow at 3:00pm for use as the Friday workshop starting point.  
Phase 1 (beta‑launchable): MVP segment builder (create, save, apply core filters, export), threshold‑based usage alerts scoped to saved segments with email and in‑app alert center, and read‑only team dashboards that surface saved segments — goal: give customers a safe, usable path to operationalize cohorts, detect key usage shifts, and share views without large infra changes.  
Phase 2 (post‑beta / GA): advanced segmentation (nested logic, time windows, membership history), composite and real‑time alerting (Slack/webhooks, suppression/escalation), full dashboard editing/sharing, scheduled reports and admin controls — goal: broaden coverage for enterprise needs and scale adoption.  
Key user journeys to prioritize: create→save segment→apply to alert/dashboard; configure alert for a segment→receive/acknowledge/triage; assemble & share dashboard→team consumption — each requires coordinated design → analytics instrumentation → backend API → frontend implementation → QA.  
Major cross‑team handoffs: backend delivers segmentation & alerting APIs to unblock frontend; UX publishes interaction specs before UI sprints; analytics finalizes event/metric definitions and instrumentation plan before build; Sales and Support confirm beta cohorts and training windows against the phase definitions.
